column1: # PASS 1 of 3.  ORDER:  calque_map  ->  era_map  ->  imla_loan_map
# Right-hand sides do NOT need to be in correct 2009/2011 imla — passes 2 and 3
# normalize them. (زۇڭتۇڭ -> پىرېزىدېنت is already correct, so nothing to fix.)
# calque_normalize.py matches a STEM at a word boundary and re-attaches the
# original suffix, and sorts rules longest-first automatically. So list STEMS
# only. Inflected forms are needed ONLY where suffix concatenation gives the
# wrong result — those are marked EXPLICIT below.
# 107 rules.  Sources: hand-seeded (incl. the web) + calque_pinyin_miner over
# and 22 on 2026-10-23 from the dictionaries, each with its evidence row in a comment above it
# or the definition of a [خەن] entry), reviewed against the scans.
# 国务院 — corpus spelling is گوۋۇيۈەن (with ۈ); گوۋۇيەن also occurs
# longest-first sorting is automatic, so جۈنشىجاڭ resolves before جۈنشى
# 2026-10-23: لېيتېنانت corrected to لېيتېنات, as printed in [2] D90-4-10128 and [1] D01-11860
# 公社 — 2011 imla dictionary p.910 gives كوممۇنا as the genuine term
# `raise`: مۇساپە is an ordinary ە-final noun, so the final vowel raises to ى
# before a suffix (مۇساپىسى، مۇساپىدە). Not the ـىيە class, which must NOT raise.
# needed because plain suffix concatenation would be ungrammatical
# فاڭجېن+ىغا would give يۆنىلىشىغا; after ى the dative is گە
# چەتئەل -> چەت ئەل : orthographic SPLIT, one token -> two.
# calque_map is the only map that supports a multiword RHS, which is why this
# lives here rather than in the imla layer despite not being a calque.
# Suffix-capturing: چەتئەلدىكى -> چەت ئەلدىكى, چەتئەلگە -> چەت ئەلگە.
# No collision: چەتئەل has no competing parse.
# ئورۇن -> ئورگان : CONTEXTUAL — only for state/administrative apparatus.
# A bare ئورۇن -> ئورگان rule would corrupt خىزمەت ئورنى, ئولتۇرۇش ئورنى, etc.
# Keyed on the collocation instead. Add further collocations as they are
# confirmed in real documents; do NOT generalize to the bare word.
# NotebookLM-confirmed variant: ئورۇن = physical workplace; state apparatus takes ئورگان
# [1] D01-11860 (target corrected 2026-10-23 to the printed گېنېرال لېيتېنات)
# [2] D90-3-05082; passes 2-3 give ئىستارشىي, as [1] D02-15598
# [4] D_13425 (target corrected 2026-10-23: يېشىللۈك was an OCR misspelling)
# reviewer; primary-school textbook fruit list, seen in a Douyin video, Oct 2026
# reviewer; primary-school textbook fruit list, seen in a Douyin video, Oct 2026
# reviewer; [4] D_15130 lists دۇنخۇاڭ, no dictionary has دۇھان
# [1] D01-12004, the spelling printed there; target [4] D_24416
# ---- Korea: the state is شىمالىي كورېيە; Korea in general (peninsula, language, script, people, war, plants) is كورېيە ----
# [4] D_12363; [1] D01-12777; the PRC country tables of 2006 and 2011 use it for North Korea
